`Progress.test.ts` tests the element of `Progress.Label`, the name of the root, the `id` prop and its change, the removal of the label, and a part outside the root.

exceptions.title: keeps every composed part synchronized through the status cycle
exceptions.reason: While the progress is indeterminate, the root has no `aria-valuetext`, because the part ships no fixed English text. WAI-ARIA 1.2 says the state by the absence of `aria-valuenow`, and a screen reader says it in the language of the user. `getAriaValueText` or `aria-valuetext` gives a text of the developer.

exceptions.title: formats with en-US until hydrated, then with the runtime locale
exceptions.reason: With no `locale`, the text has the locale of the nearest `LocaleProvider`, else `en-US`, on the server and in the browser, so it does not change after the hydration (VUE-170).

exceptions.title: indeterminate value %s
exceptions.reason: While the progress is indeterminate, `formattedValue` is `null`, as its type says. `state.status` in the same slot says the status, and the developer gives the text.

exceptions.title: hydrates $name without a mismatch, then uses the runtime locale
exceptions.reason: With no `locale`, the text has the locale of the nearest `LocaleProvider`, else `en-US`, on the server and in the browser, so it does not change after the hydration (VUE-170). The case of VUE-170 hydrates `Progress.Value` with no message.
The prop is optional, with the default `null`. A native `<progress>` with no `value` is indeterminate, and `null` stays valid, so the wider type removes no feature.
`aria-valuetext` is an attribute, not a prop. It reaches the element with the other attributes, and it wins over the text of the part.
